messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@skylark.com>

Cc: Ben Chang <ben.chang@skylark.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership demo and recording request

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — Skylark is excited to see Redwood’s latency/cost runbook in action. Our CIO (Ben Chang) and VP of ML Ops are aiming to join a short leadership demo to validate the fit for a pilot. Can you confirm availability for leadership-level demo the week of July 5? Ideally we'd lock a 45min slot where we can walk through:

- Pilot goals and success metrics
- Data handling and VPC options
- SLAs and fallbacks (dedicated vs hosted)

One important note: our security team requires explicit consent if the session is recorded and asks that we receive any recording plus a short transcript. I’ve attached a one-pager with their checklist.

Could you send a couple of VP/CIO-friendly options and confirm if Redwood will be recording (and how you handle storage/access)?

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee | Director, Platform Strategy
Skylark Labs
attachments: skylark_requirements.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership demo and recording request

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the checklist, that helps.

We can run a compact, leadership-focused demo plus Q&A in 45 minutes. Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Jul 6 — 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed, Jul 7 — 1:00–1:45pm PT

We will record the session for internal follow-up. Redwood can host the recording for 90 days and provide an encrypted download link for your security team; if you need a separate retention policy, we can discuss a short-term S3 export. Please confirm if that approach meets your security checklist.

I've attached a short exec brief (redwood_exec_brief_v1.pdf) that outlines who will speak from our side and the agenda. Our exec sponsor for this engagement will be Lauren Bishop — she will attend to handle strategy/QoS questions. Ben Carter will run the demo.

If those windows work, I’ll send a calendar invite and request the recording consent in the invite notes.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

2) 10–25m — Live demo (Ben Carter)
3) 25–40m — Security/ops deep-dive (Rishi)
4) 40–45m — Next steps & mutual action plan
